nodes.name: IF: Valid Message?
nodes.notes: Guards: ignore own messages, empty text, old events, and group chats.

nodes.name: Code: Log Invalid Reason
nodes.notes: Captures why a message was rejected. Check execution logs to see invalid_reason, age_seconds, and message_type for debugging.

assignments.name: phone
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const d = ($json.body?.data ?? $json.data) || {}; const src = [d.sender, d.remoteJidAlt, d.key?.remoteJidAlt, d.key?.remoteJid].find(v => typeof v === 'string' && v.includes('@s.whatsapp.net')) || [d.sender, d.remoteJidAlt, d.key?.remoteJidAlt, d.key?.remoteJid].find(v => typeof v === 'string' && v.length) || ''; return src.replace('@s.whatsapp.net', '').replace(/\D/g, ''); })() }}

'').trim(); })() }}

nodes.name: Set: Extract Fields
nodes.notes: Normalizes payload fields used by the workflow (phone, text, message_id, timestamp).

nodes.name: Code: Dedup & Volume Check
nodes.notes: Anti-ban protection: dedup by message_id/text, per-user cooldown, global per-minute limit, and daily cap.

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ number: $json.phone, text: $json.reply, delay: 1500, linkPreview: false }) }}

nodes.name: HTTP: Send Reply
nodes.notes: Sends reply text via Evolution API. Uses configured instance and API key.

nodes.name: Sheets: Append Log
nodes.notes: Writes audit log row to Google Sheets message_log tab for traceability.

nodes.name: Code: Email Extract & Classify
nodes.notes: Extracts email from message text via regex, normalizes to lowercase, and classifies intent_type using Butterfly Digital Marketing keyword guide (free_gifts / paid_products / planner_order / full_bundle / free_consultation / private_consultation / other).

nodes.name: IF: Has Email?
nodes.notes: TRUE → message contains email → look up / upsert in email_leads sheet. FALSE → no email found → skip lead processing.

nodes.name: No Op: No Email
nodes.notes: Message contained no email address — lead not created. Reply path already completed.

nodes.name: IF: No Email Has Phone?
nodes.notes: Without email, only create no_email lead when user sends a phone number in the same message.

nodes.name: Sheets: Append No Email Lead
nodes.notes: When message has no email, append a lead row with status=no_email using synthetic key no_email:{phone}.

nodes.name: Sheets: Read Email Leads
nodes.notes: Reads all rows from email_leads tab. alwaysOutputData=true ensures the next Code node runs even when the sheet is empty.

nodes.name: Code: Email Upsert Logic
nodes.notes: Searches existing email_leads rows for a matching email. Sets email_exists=true and preserves original created_at for updates; sets status='new' or 'updated' accordingly.

nodes.name: IF: Email Exists?
nodes.notes: TRUE → email already in sheet → update existing row (last_seen_at, intent, phone, message). FALSE → new email → append fresh row.

nodes.name: Sheets: Update Email Lead
nodes.notes: Updates the existing email_leads row matching on email column: refreshes last_seen_at, latest_message, intent_type, phone, name_hint, status=updated.

nodes.name: Sheets: Append Email Lead
nodes.notes: Appends a brand-new row to email_leads for a first-time email. Columns: created_at, last_seen_at, email, phone, name_hint, intent_type, latest_message, message_id, source, status=new.

nodes.name: IF: Outgoing Message?
nodes.notes: Human handoff: detects manual replies sent from WhatsApp (fromMe=true).

assignments.name: phone
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const d = ($json.body?.data ?? $json.data) || {}; const src = [d.sender, d.remoteJidAlt, d.key?.remoteJidAlt, d.key?.remoteJid].find(v => typeof v === 'string' && v.includes('@s.whatsapp.net')) || [d.sender, d.remoteJidAlt, d.key?.remoteJidAlt, d.key?.remoteJid].find(v => typeof v === 'string' && v.length) || ''; return src.replace('@s.whatsapp.net', '').replace(/\D/g, ''); })() }}

nodes.name: IF: Chat Paused?
nodes.notes: Stops bot + leads when chat is in human handoff (24h from last manual reply).

nodes.name: Cron: Every 30 Minutes
nodes.notes: Runs every 30 minutes to scan sheet rows marked Done=TRUE.

nodes.name: Sheets: Read Product PDF Map
nodes.notes: Rows: product_code | pdf_url | label_ar (optional). Codes must match Form column "product_code" on عمليات الدفع.

nodes.name: Sheets: Read Payment Rows
nodes.notes: Tab "عمليات الدفع". Google Form must include column "product_code" (dropdown codes). Done → confirmation + PDF from tab "product_pdf_map". Evolution instance: Yas.

nodes.name: Merge: Payments And Product Map
nodes.notes: Append: payment rows then product map rows. Code splits by طابع زمني vs product_code.

nodes.name: Code: Filter Eligible Rows
nodes.notes: Splits Merge output into payment rows vs product_pdf_map; builds confirmation + PDF link.

nodes.name: IF: Ready To Send?
nodes.notes: Rows failing prechecks are marked failed with last_error without calling Evolution.

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ number: $json.phone, text: $json.confirmation_text, delay: 1200, linkPreview: false }) }}

nodes.name: HTTP: Send Payment Confirmation
nodes.notes: Sends payment confirmation via Evolution API. continueOnFail=true keeps flow alive per row.

nodes.name: IF: Send Success?
nodes.notes: TRUE branch: mark whatsapp_status=sent. FALSE branch: mark failed.

nodes.name: Sheets: Mark Sent
nodes.notes: Updates row status to sent to prevent duplicate sends in future runs.

nodes.name: Sheets: Mark Failed
nodes.notes: Marks failed attempts so they can be monitored and retried manually.

nodes.name: Sheets: Read Paused Chats (Payment)
nodes.notes: Human handoff: skip payment WhatsApp when chat is paused (24h after manual reply).
